items.name: DYNEQ_BAND_ONS

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/dyneq.json at 10c5d46376e6, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_dyneq_instance.h#sw

items.doc: A band's switch. Off, the band is not in the EQ's bank and its dynamics do not run; on, its static section runs, parked at 0 dB as an EQ band is, and its dynamics run as its dynMode says. A band comes up off, as an EQ band does: the ids and the come-up value are EQ_BAND_ONS's, the EQ's own band switch, and the face holds the two equal at compile time.

items.name: DYNEQ_BAND_TYPES

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/dyneq.json at 10c5d46376e6, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_dyneq_instance.h#type

items.doc: The band's shape, in the order of the integer the kernel reads, which is the order of the first three EQ_BAND_TYPES: a bell, a low shelf, a high shelf. A bell's dynamics act through the cookbook bandpass at its centre, a shelf's through half of the first-order allpass at its corner (omx_band_dyn_design).

items.name: DYNEQ_FREQ_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/dyneq.json at 10c5d46376e6, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_dyneq_instance.h#fc

items.doc: The band's centre or corner, the EQ band's travel by reference. The come-up centres are the EQ's default rule for six bands (omx_eq_default_centres), so the bands start spread across the audio band.

items.name: DYNEQ_GAIN_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/dyneq.json at 10c5d46376e6, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_dyneq_instance.h#g

items.doc: The band's static gain, the EQ band's travel by reference: the curve the band draws with its dynamics at rest. 0 dB parks the static section, as on the EQ, and the dynamics still act.

items.name: DYNEQ_Q_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/dyneq.json at 10c5d46376e6, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_dyneq_instance.h#bq

items.doc: The bell's Q, the EQ band's travel by reference; the dynamics' bandpass takes the same Q. A shelf reads it as the EQ's shelf does.

items.name: DYNEQ_DYN_MODES

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/dyneq.json at 10c5d46376e6, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_dyneq_instance.h#dyn_mode_i

items.doc: Whether and when the band's dynamics act, in the order of the integer the kernel reads: off, the band is its static section alone; down, it acts above its threshold, when the band is loud (band_dyn's above); up, it acts below its threshold, when the band is quiet (band_dyn's below). The range's sign says whether it cuts or boosts. A band comes up off, so a fresh dynamic EQ is an EQ.

items.name: DYNEQ_THRESHOLD_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/dyneq.json at 10c5d46376e6, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_dyneq_instance.h#thr

items.doc: Where the band's dynamics start, in dB of the band's own level after its static section: band_dyn's threshold travel by reference.

items.name: DYNEQ_RATIO_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/dyneq.json at 10c5d46376e6, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_dyneq_instance.h#rat

items.doc: How hard the band is held past its threshold: band_dyn's ratio travel by reference.

items.name: DYNEQ_RANGE_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/dyneq.json at 10c5d46376e6, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_dyneq_instance.h#rng

items.doc: The most the dynamics add to the band's static gain, signed: below zero the deepest cut, above zero the largest boost. band_dyn's range travel by reference.

items.name: DYNEQ_ATTACK_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/dyneq.json at 10c5d46376e6, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_dyneq_instance.h#att

items.doc: The band detector's attack, in ms: band_dyn's attack travel by reference, which stops at the oversampling floor; a step reaches 56.65 % at the attack time (the 4-stage cascade).

items.name: DYNEQ_RELEASE_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/dyneq.json at 10c5d46376e6, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_dyneq_instance.h#rel

items.doc: The band detector's release, in ms: band_dyn's release travel by reference; a step falls to 43.35 % at the release time (the 4-stage cascade).

items.name: DYNEQ_LISTENS

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/dyneq.json at 10c5d46376e6, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_dyneq_instance.h#lis

items.doc: While on, the output is what the band's detector hears, its section B over the signal reaching the band, in place of the EQ's output; with more than one band listening, their sum. It comes up off.

items.name: DYNEQ_MIX_PCT_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/dyneq.json at 10c5d46376e6, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_dyneq_instance.h#mix_share

items.doc: The share of the processed output, in percent: 100 is the dynamic EQ alone, bit for bit, 0 the input.

items.name: DYNEQ_BANDS

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/dyneq.json at 10c5d46376e6, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_dyneq_instance.h#OMX_DYNEQ_INSTANCE_BANDS

items.doc: How many bands the dynamic EQ carries, each a static EQ section and its dynamics: six, the floating bands of the reference desks' dynamic EQs. Its state holds this many band-dynamics states.
